name: The Multum Case
source:
You finally have Morgan Multum in your custody,  all that's left now is a line of questioning...

Will you find out what happened to the other Multum brother?

[From [url=https://superonion19.itch.io/the-multum-case]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你终于逮住了摩根·马尔特姆，现在只剩下一连串的问题要问…

你能查出马尔特姆兄弟中的另一个究竟出了什么事吗？
